body: Busy session (turn running or permission prompt waiting): console command is refused with a reply in the topic, not queued. Alternative rejected: hub-side queue until turn end (needs persistence and ordering against the slot buffer; user can resend).

Bang output and local-command-stdout render in transcript::stream_events as Note with a fenced code block (fence longer than any backtick run), bash-input as Prompt '! cmd'. Alternative rejected: new wire StreamItem kind (needs hub+agent protocol change; Note already renders markdown).

Capability is a new Register field console_commands plus HubMsg console_command / AgentMsg console_command_typed, wire VERSION unchanged. Alternative rejected: reuse console_keys (old agents would get an unknown message type and never answer).
